title: Research Scientist - Nemotron India
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
We are looking for Research Scientists passionate about large generative models! We are searching for world-class researchers in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) to join our applied deep learning research team which pioneered the Megatron, MT-NLG, and DLSS projects at NVIDIA. Our team is pushing the boundaries of generative AI by building state-of-the-art large language and multi-modal foundation models and applying them to solve real-world problems. If you are passionate about the latest research and technologies revolutionizing generative AI and want to explore creative new paradigms for applied foundation models such as software assistants and customized multi-modal agents, this team will be a great fit for you. After building prototypes that demonstrate the promise of your research, you will collaborate with product teams to apply your ideas into industry-leading real-world applications.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop deep learning-based approaches to improve and advance large language models (LLMs) and large multi-modal models.
* Design and implement machine learning techniques to adapt foundation models to downstream tasks of interest such as software assistant and multi-turn multi-modal and multi-lingual dialogue system.
* Construct and curate datasets for large-scale machine learning, for learning from human preferences, and for specific domains of applications.
* Work closely with product and hardware architecture teams to integrate your research and developments into products.

**What We Need To See**

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience.
* Extensive machine learning / deep learning research or work experience.
* Knowledge of application areas such as natural language processing and computer vision.
* Excellent programming skills in some rapid prototyping environments such as Python; C++ and parallel programming (e.g., CUDA) is a plus.
* Expertise with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
* A track record of research excellence demonstrated in publications at leading conferences and journals.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/NVIDIA is committed to encouraging a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

* Build and tune content delivery with Amazon CloudFront, including SPA/static asset delivery, caching behaviors, deep-link handling, and edge functions.
* Develop and maintain Python back-end services and REST APIs that are secure, performant, and well-tested.
* Build and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, with hands-on use of S3, Aurora (PostgreSQL), Step Functions, AWS Glue, Lambda, and Caching services.
* Design data pipelines and orchestration using Step Functions and Glue for ETL, data processing, and workflow automation.
* Design and model relational data on Aurora, with attention to performance, integrity, and security.
* Deploy and support containerized services on EKS, working with the gateway and Istio service mesh (JWT validation, mTLS).
* Containerize and deploy services and support CI/CD pipelines for reliable, repeatable releases.
* Contribute to Infrastructure-as-Code to provision and manage environments.
* Implement observability - logging, metrics, and tracing to monitor health and troubleshoot issues.
* Write clean, maintainable code following secure coding and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with product, design, security, and fellow engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and delivery planning.

title: Software Engineer - II, AI/ML
description:

Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Software Engineer II, AI/ML, you will design, build, and deploy Generative AI and machine learning solutions that power enterprise applications — from intelligent assistants and RAG-based systems to agentic workflow automation — working across the full AI pipeline from data ingestion to production inference.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build Generative AI features for enterprise applications, including text generation, summarization, and RAG-based intelligent assistants
* Design and orchestrate multi-agent AI systems that automate complex workflows and decision-making
* Design, train, and deploy machine learning models to solve classification, regression, NLP, and other business problems
* Own AI pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion through model inference and serving
* Evaluate and monitor model and agent performance in production, iterating based on results
* Write clean, scalable, production-ready code and maintain source control and CI/CD workflows
* Partner with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to ship AI capabilities

**Desired Experience**
**Generative AI & LLM Applications**

* Experience developing Generative AI solutions using large language models (LLMs) for enterprise use cases such as text generation, summarization, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Experience building intelligent assistants and conversational AI applications powered by LLMs
* Familiarity with vector databases for RAG retrieval, such as AWS OpenSearch, pgVector, or Databricks AI Search

**Agentic AI & Orchestration**

* Experience implementing Agentic AI systems using multi-agent frameworks to automate complex workflows and decision-making pipelines
* Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration and agentic workflow development
* Experience using Pydantic AI for structured data validation and AI model integration

**Machine Learning**

* Experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models for classification, regression, NLP, and other AI use cases
* Hands-on experience with Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, and TensorFlow/Keras

**AI Pipelines & Evaluation**

* Experience building and maintaining AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, model inference, and serving
* Familiarity with evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, or Weights & Biases
* Familiarity with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI

**Software Engineering & Tools**

* Experience writing clean, scalable, production-ready code in Python
* Experience using VS Code or similar IDEs, and leveraging AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate development productivity
* Experience managing source code, branching strategies, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub

**Collaboration & Process**

* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams following Agile/Scrum methodologies

**Good to Have**

* Experience developing and managing data pipelines, ML workflows, and AI applications on the Databricks platform
* Experience building or contributing to internal AI-powered web applications using ReactJS

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, with 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in an IT technical role
* Experience developing and deploying ML solutions using core libraries and frameworks including Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras
* Experience working on GenAI and Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex
* Familiarity with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Software Engineer (PLC) -Control System Engineering
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation.
  
  
As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors.
  
  
Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
PLC Software Development
  
  

* Understand PLC Software Development
* Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards.
* Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems.
* Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms.
* Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration
  
  

* Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I).
* Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions.
* Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems.

System Engineering
  
  

* Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture.
* Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies.
* Support system design reviews and risk assessments.

Troubleshooting & RCA
  
  

* Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities.
* Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Manufacturing & Customer Support
  
  

* Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities.
* Provide technical support during customer escalations.
* Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams.
* Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements.
* Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Drive software standardization and code modularization.

* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

Our GRID Product Provides Hyperlocal Geospatial Intelligence Solution That Supports Various Industries Like Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, Travel & Logistics In Making Data-backed, Intelligent Decisions. GRID Brings Together Both Functional Expertise And Scalable Tech Stack For
  
  

* Site-level intelligence on asset supply coverage and user experience (for both client and competitors)
* Advanced Analytics platform for scenario modelling and optimization algorithms
* Enhanced real-time visualization and collaboration, distributed across the client org (assets, strategy, marketing etc.)
* Working with cross-functional teams using a ‘single source of truth’ that aligns customer “demand” data and asset “supply” data

The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in geospatial analytics with strong project management skills to deliver impactful solutions across various domains such as CAPEX Optimization, Go-to-market, Cost to serve, Market Attractiveness, White space opportunity, Competitive intensity etc. across multiple industries with focus on Telecom (Fiber, Tower and Data Centre), Retail, Healthcare, Travel and Hospitality etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Building a high performing global centre of excellence for geospatial analytics within Performance Improvement Practice
* Executing the collection, processing, and analysis of geospatial data using advanced GIS tools and methodologies
* Develop and maintain geospatial databases to ensure data integrity and accuracy
* Contribute to the creation of high-quality maps and visualizations that effectively communicate data insights
* Support senior analysts in conducting spatial analyses and modelling
* Assist in implementing spatial analysis techniques such as distance calculations and spatial overlays
* Assist in managing GIS projects across various disciplines, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance technical skills in geospatial technologies
* Position A&M Global Capability Center as a thought partner within the firm for building new solutions and offerings

**Qualifications**

* Comes with 1-5 years of relevant hands-on experience working with a global consulting firm, delivering geospatial driven analytics consulting services delivery for corporate and PE clients
* MBA or Master’s from a top-tier institute
* Have strong knowledge on various spatial models and algorithms to solve complex problems
* Proficiency in solutions around Geo Spatial Analytics (custom solutions, scenario modelling, large volume rendering, foot traffic, shape file formats)
* Proficiency in technical skills
* Python (Geospatial libraries like geopandas), SQL, Alteryx
* Visualization tools (ArcGIS, QGIS, PowerBI, CARTO)
* Statistical Analysis methodologies (Gradient Boost, Random Forest)
* Microsoft Office Suite (must have)
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

* Experience with APIs, microservices, and containerized deployments in enterprise environments.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, and data integration across structured and unstructured sources.

* Experience presenting technical solutions, results, and recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.

* Experience with semantic search, vector retrieval, document intelligence, conversational AI, and knowledge-grounded AI systems.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI, model governance, explainability, bias detection, risk controls, and enterprise AI safety practices.
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery models.
* Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving implementation across multiple stakeholders.
* Advanced expertise in AI/LLMs with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end model development and deployment.
* Solid data engineering background with experience in building and managing complex, large-scale data systems.
* Proven ability to work effectively in large, collaborative teams within fast-paced, enterprise environments.

* Strong ownership and accountability for end-to-end delivery
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical AI solutions
* Strong collaboration across engineering, product, business, and governance teams
* Technical leadership in solution design and implementation
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Continuous learning mindset with focus on emerging AI technologies and best practices
